items.informal_name: Convexity of the Kullback-Leibler Divergence Function on the Positive Reals
items.informal_description: The Kullback-Leibler divergence function $ f(x) = x \ln x + 1 - x $ is convex on the interval $ (0, \infty) $.

The Gamma function is convex on the interval $(0, \infty)$, meaning that for all $x, y \in (0, \infty)$ and scalars $a, b \in [0, 1]$ with $a + b = 1$, the inequality $\Gamma(ax + by) \leq a\Gamma(x) + b\Gamma(y)$ holds.

items.informal_name: Strictly Decreasing Reciprocal Function on Positive Elements
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [PosMulReflectLT α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],
  StrictAntiOn (fun x => 1 / x) (Set.Ioi 0)
items.informal_description: The function $f(x) = \frac{1}{x}$ is strictly decreasing on the interval $(0, \infty)$, meaning that for all $a, b \in (0, \infty)$ with $a < b$, it holds that $\frac{1}{a} > \frac{1}{b}$.

items.informal_name: Convexity of $ x^n $ on $ (0, \infty) $ for Integer $ n $
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : Field 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] (n : ℤ),
  ConvexOn 𝕜 (Set.Ioi 0) fun x => x ^ n
items.informal_description: For any integer $ n $, the function $ f(x) = x^n $ is convex on the interval $ (0, \infty) $ in a linearly ordered field $ \mathbb{K} $.

The inverse function $ f(x) = x^{-1} $ is strictly decreasing on the interval $ (0, +\infty] $ of the extended real numbers. For any $ a, b \in (0, +\infty] $ with $ a < b $, it holds that $ a^{-1} > b^{-1} $.

items.informal_name: Strict Decreasingness of the Inverse Function on Positive Elements
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [PosMulReflectLT α],
  StrictAntiOn (fun x => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0)
items.informal_description: The inverse function $ f(x) = x^{-1} $ is strictly decreasing on the set of positive elements $ \{ x \in \alpha \mid 0 < x \} $. Specifically, for any $ a, b $ in this set, if $ a < b $, then $ a^{-1} > b^{-1} $.

items.informal_name: The inverse function is antitone on the positive elements
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Field α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [PosMulReflectLT α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],
  AntitoneOn (fun x => x⁻¹) (Set.Ioi 0)
items.informal_description: For all $ a, b $ in the set $ \{x \mid 0 < x\} $, if $ a \leq b $, then $ b^{-1} \leq a^{-1} $. This states that the inverse function $ x \mapsto x^{-1} $ reverses the order on positive elements in an ordered field.
